Markets.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
Markets.summary: Yes Bank has asked the Supreme Court to review an October 15 order that upheld a ruling quashing the bank's write-off of Rs 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. The High Court had previously determined that the bank's administrator lacked the authority to write off these bonds during its financial crisis.

Markets.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
Markets.summary: RHI Magnesita reported a 62% increase in net profit to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. Consolidated revenues reached Rs 1,038.26 crore while overall expenses decreased compared to the previous year.

Markets.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
Markets.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering to raise nearly Rs 9,500 crore. The proposed IPO involves parent company Coal India selling a 10 percent stake, consisting of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
Markets.summary: The Nifty index has a positive technical outlook following a strong rebound near its 200-week moving average. However, the index is currently trading close to a key overhead resistance level.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: An analysis of the stock market identified 8 specific equities that posted gains for five consecutive days. These stocks generated cumulative returns ranging between 7% and 11% over the period.

Markets.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
Markets.summary: Binance plans to fully reopen withdrawals for all networks and assets by the end of next week. The exchange has recovered 95% of the funds lost in the October hack and will fully reimburse affected clients.

Geo-Political.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the US proposed Ukraine ceding the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership. While US officials have not confirmed this specific claim, they noted that various ideas continue to be discussed.

Geo-Political.title: Copper wire upgrade behind US flight suspension, transport secretary says
Geo-Political.summary: The U.S. government is investigating whether a copper wire upgrade that caused widespread flight suspensions was the result of incompetence or faulty equipment. Transport Secretary Pete Buttigieg stated that authorities are examining the root cause of the aviation chaos.

Geo-Political.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from closing Washington DC golf course for renovation
Geo-Political.summary: A judge has temporarily blocked Donald Trump from closing the East Potomac Golf Links in Washington, D.C., for renovations. This ruling is the latest development in an ongoing, months-long legal challenge against the U.S. president's plans for the course.

Geo-Political.title: Fifth Canadian soldier dies from injuries caused by large fire at military base
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian soldier Private William Douglas Dal Bianco died on Friday from injuries sustained in a fire at CFB Wainwright. He is the fifth military member to die as a result of the large blaze that swept through the base a month ago.

Geo-Political.title: Three men sentenced to death in Jordan over fatal church mass shooting
Geo-Political.summary: Three men were sentenced to death in Jordan for a fatal mass shooting at a Greek Orthodox church funeral last month. The attack resulted in nine deaths and 34 injuries.

Geo-Political.title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: An Israeli strike on a Gaza camp killed Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Hamas Rafah Brigade. Both Hamas and Israeli military officials confirmed his death.

AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications and games work without needing to read source code or learn disassemblers. This tool provides evidence-backed explanations of app mechanics and features through simple AI interactions.

Data & Insights.title: Oil, El Niño and capital flight: Can India retain its fast-growth tag?
Data & Insights.summary: Although India is currently the world's fastest-growing major economy, rising crude oil prices, dry weather, and market outflows threaten its growth. These external pressures will test the country's economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Why your monthly grocery bill is rising: Onion prices jump 116%, garlic 61% as South India feels inflation heat
Data & Insights.summary: In October, retail inflation across all five South Indian states exceeded the 6.09% national average due to rising food costs. Specifically, onion prices surged by 116% and garlic prices jumped by 61%, increasing pressure on household budgets.

Data & Insights.title: Indian solar manufacturers look to Germany as China proposes curbs on technology exports
Data & Insights.summary: China is proposing curbs on solar technology exports that could negatively impact India's goal of building a domestic solar manufacturing ecosystem. Specifically, these restrictions threaten India's projection to build 100 gigawatts of capacity for wafers, ingots, and polysilicon by the end of the decade.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding economists' expectations of 6%. This rate crosses the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6% for the first time in two years.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to guarantee policy continuity for investors. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing economic reforms to accelerate business growth in the state.

India.title: Punjab Congress Forms Fail-Safe Panel To Induct Turncoats Ahead Of Polls
India.summary: The Punjab Congress has created a committee to manage the intake of politicians switching parties before the elections. This panel will coordinate and oversee the joining process for leaders leaving other parties to join the Congress.

India.title: Children Were Shouting 'Save Us': Eyewitness Recalls Assam Bus-Truck Crash
India.summary: At least 26 people were killed and several others injured after a bus and a truck collided head-on in Assam. Local residents rushed to the scene to rescue victims, with eyewitnesses reporting hearing children shouting for help.

India.title: US Aviation Team To Visit India Tomorrow: Why The Safety Audit Matters
India.summary: A US aviation team will visit India tomorrow to conduct a safety audit. The assessment will focus on the DGCA's ability to comply with international safety standards.

India.title: Row Over Order To Shut Meat Shops In West Bengal's Rampurhat For Chhath Puja
India.summary: A municipal body in West Bengal's Rampurhat ordered meat shops to close for Chhath Puja, sparking a political row. The municipal chairman denied the decision targeted any community, stating it respected the religious sentiments of the festival.

India.title: Odisha Class 10 Board Exam 2027 To Begin On March 12; Check Details Here
India.summary: The Odisha Class 10 board exams for 2027 are scheduled to begin on March 12. Students can access the subject-wise timetable on the official board website, bseodisha.nic.in, once it is released.

India.title: ICSI CSEET October 2026 Toppers: Bhakti Sanjay Shah Secured Rank 1
India.summary: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India released the October 2026 CSEET exam results on November 15, 2026. Bhakti Sanjay Shah achieved Rank 1 on the official toppers' list.

General.title: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
General.summary: Former Metropolitan Police inspector Warren Arter lied about the death of his wife, who was found in a blood-stained hotel room in Barbados. Arter also faced allegations that he sexually exploited crime victims.

General.title: Minister backs legal right to job support for young people
General.summary: The work and pensions secretary supports a legal right to job support for young people. She stated that the current level of support is too vague.

General.title: Alleged Russell Brand rape victim wants age of consent law changed
General.summary: Mia Latter, who states she met a convicted rapist at age 16, is advocating for a staggered age of consent law. She wants the legal framework updated to better protect minors from predatory older men.

General.title: Man and woman die and four arrested after police pursuit crash in Leeds
General.summary: A man and a woman died following a crash in Leeds that occurred during a police pursuit. Four people have been arrested on suspicion of causing death by dangerous driving.

General.title: Hannah Fry feels 'unbelievably lucky' after cervical cancer treatment
General.summary: The presenter says she has received a 'five-year clear' after having a hysterectomy in her thirties.

General.title: Watch: SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
General.summary: SpaceX successfully caught returning parts of its Starship rocket using mechanical arms called chopsticks. This achievement marks a historic milestone in rocket recovery and aerospace engineering.
